notes: StorageGRID capacity IS available from Active IQ (StorageGrid.gridCapacity, per grid on the admin-node system) -- the UI's 'not reported via the Active IQ GraphQL API' message was wrong. 4 of 6 real grids return it. Verified usableKiB is remaining space (usable + used data + used metadata + reserved metadata reconciles to actual). Harvested via the same small dedicated query as E-Series capacity, mapped into the standard capacity fields, and shown in a grid panel. Surfaces a real risk that was invisible: the Salasala grid is 96% used with 2.0 TiB remaining.
